sample_unit: anonymized real-life patient cases with multiple-choice questions

links.outcome: Concordance with guideline-author gold standard, LLMs versus board-certified colposcopists, cervical dysplasia management
links.effect: Overall concordance 69.6% clinicians, 69.6% ChatGPT-4o, 65.2% ChatGPT-5. ChatGPT-5 beat clinicians in precancerous lesions (81.8% vs 66.4%); clinicians better in unspecific histopathology (86% vs 60%).
links.quote: Clinicians and LLMs achieved similar overall concordance rates compared to the gold standard (69.6% for clinicians, 69.6% for ChatGPT-4o, and 65.2% for ChatGPT-5).

screen.reason: Compares LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and ChatGPT-5) to human colposcopists on clinical case vignettes (multiple-choice questions) without evaluating a deployment guardrail or workflow intervention.
